item.title: COMING Friday November 20th | Last Waltz – A 50th Anniversary Celebration — Tue Nov 17 — Pisgah Brewing Company Black Mountain
item.description:
November 20, 2026 8:00 PM | From $22.71 adv. Event Details and Tickets Hey everyone we are thrilled to announce that members of @cloudsofdelusionofficial and @sunsofstars are coming together to celebrate the 50th anniversary of The Last Waltz at Pisgah Brewing Company! Inspired by The Band’s legendary farewell concert at San Francisco’s Winterland Ballroom on Thanksgiving Day 1976, our local musicians recreate one of the most celebrated nights in rock history.
Founded in 2005, Pisgah is known for producing some of the most sought after craft ales in Western North Carolina. Pisgah Brewing Company currently operates the new indoor taproom with live music several days a week, plus our outdoor music venue in the summer and fall months with live music frequently on WNC’s premier outdoor music venue, the Pisgah Brewing Outdoor Stage. Be sure to come thirsty and ready rock! Check out our upcoming schedule at pisgahbrewing.com/events
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.description:

Originally from Wisconsin, he began his musical journey in Alaska in the late ’90s with The Photonz, a jam band known for its energetic mix of bluegrass and rock. item.title: 9:15 Contemplative Service — Sun Nov 22, 9:15 AM — *1 Sanctuary
item.description:
At 9:15 AM, we have a 40-45 minute Contemplative Worship Service. This service invites participants into a reflective, more meditative space, and includes silence, beautiful recorded music and videos, and opportunities for sharing. It also features the sermon and theme which will be the focus in the second service at 11:15 AM. This service is not livestreamed., and it include childcare but not a full religious education program. This service will be particularly good if you need quiet in order to hear well or focus, would prefer a little more space around you, or seek a more contemplative communal experience. Between services, at 10 am we will have coffee hour and special programs. Whether you come to the early service or the later service, we encourage you to consider arriving at 10 am for coffee, conversation, and special programs including conversations with the Board, or Minister & lay-led justice or adult education offerings.
Source: Unitarian Universalist Congregation of Ashevi

item.title: No Name/Graveyard Loop; a Saunter. — Mon Nov 23, 9:45 AM
item.description: Hendo Fun Friends We will ‘scout’ the newly created trail into Graveyard Fields. And make a ‘loop’ including a section of old MTS trail. Remember - hikes led by ‘the Curmudgeon’ tend to have pleasant surprises. Up to 12 ppl are welcome to join us. **OPTIONAL: A 3.0 MILE LOOP IS AVAILABLE. HUGH WILL LEAD. ADD ½ HR.** **Please indicate which version you are attending.. 😉** **Difficulty:** 1 mile of descending gravel service road. The remaining is single-trak trail with rocks, roots and occasional ‘hi-steps’. I will be carrying the ‘Ent-Ward’ that gives us permission to pass thru the forest. We are the **Sloth Hike Team of WNC**: “We will get there when we get there.” We dare to go where the ‘real’ hike groups don’t ***!!*** ***https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TQ8H4EK2vt4*** Hike Details: **Social ‘hour’ at 9:45a; “Saddle up” at 9:55a.** Hike Distance: 2.0miles; Accum ascent: 300 ft; Pace: **1.5mph** **Drive time: 23mi/40min 1-way (via Hwy 276)** **Return Not earlier than: 2 PM (=1.5 hrs)*
